nodes.natural_language: A point $(x,y)$ on the coordinate plane with both coordinates negative is a distance of 6 units from the $x$-axis. It is a distance of 15 units from the point $(8,3)$. It is a distance $\sqrt{n}$ from the origin. What is $n$? Show that it is 52.
